notes: Account background: WillowGate builds conversational assistants and backend reranking for retail banking products (loan origination, fraud triage). High compliance bar (SOC2 + ISO). Want a vendor that can guarantee predictable unit economics and clear escalation paths.
Primary ask: Dedicated capacity with firm throughput guarantees and a legally-backed SLA (uptime, credit schedule). Also need reserved GPU planning for seasonal peaks (quarter-end surge).

Workload profile: mix of chat (customer support), embeddings for semantic search, and reranking for transaction fraud scoring. Peak concurrency estimate: ~2k concurrent sessions, average response size 150-250 tokens, peak request burst up to 500 req/s for chat and 800 req/s for embeddings/reranking spread across models.

Latency SLO targets proposed by customer: p95 < 450ms for chat (<= 128 token responses), p99 < 900ms; embeddings batch turnaround < 2s; reranking p95 < 250ms. Customer asks for explicit p99 tail allowances in SLA.

Throughput/Reserve ask: planning guidance for dedicated pool: customer expects sizing to support sustained 200k tokens/min and burst capacity to 600k tokens/min. They prefer H100-equivalent reservations (initial ask: 6x H100 80GB or cloud-equivalent), but want Redwood SE to provide cost/size tradeoffs (quantization + batching recommendations).
SLA negotiation points in flight:
- Uptime target: WillowGate requests 99.995% (four 9s). Redwood initial offer: 99.95%. Legal is pushing for higher uptime and stricter credits.

- Credit schedule: WillowGate wants meaningful financial credits at 99.99 and below with stepwise scale (e.g., 10% credit for <99.99, 25% for <99.95, 50% for <99.9). Redwood counters with smaller escalations and caps tied to monthly committed spend.

- Maintenance windows: customer requires pre-notified maintenance outside of 02:00-06:00 ET; asks for max 4 maintenance windows/yr for critical infra. Redwood proposes 6 windows and a rolling upgrade policy with pre-notification. Customer wants a blackout window for month-end reporting days.

- Support SLAs: WillowGate requests P1 response <15 minutes and on-call engagement until remediation. Redwood standard P1 response is 1 hour (enterprise SLA add-on moves to 30min). Negotiation ongoing; customer emphasized operational readiness for production fraud system.
- Data residency & auditability: must support EU residency for certain datasets and provide KMS integration + audit log retention 7 years (or enterprise add-on).
